title: Spectral DEMATEL: a browser-based diagnosis of DEMATEL influence matrices
description:
A Shiny application that diagnoses a DEMATEL influence matrix: the structural type of the system, whether the matrix is in scope at all, how influence enters and accumulates, which single relationship moves the system most, and how firmly any of that is held.

It runs entirely in the browser. Compiled to WebAssembly with shinylive and webR, it needs no server and no installation, and no matrix a user pastes ever leaves their machine.

Every spectral quantity it shows is computed by the spectralDEMATEL R package, which is the single implementation of every definition; this application draws and explains, and computes nothing of its own.

The repository is named DEMATEL.Sensitivity because a published article cites that exact address. The tool outgrew the name: sensitivity analysis is now one section of it.
